hero.lead: Onboard companies, manage your participants, and run their connectors and wallets as a service, in the dataspace that the Core Service Provider keeps trusted.

how.title: One portal between your company and the dataspace
how.intro: Every onboarding service provider runs its own portal for the companies it serves. The Eclipse Tractus-X Dataspace Management is that portal: open source, and the same for every provider.

join.title: Join
join.text: Your company registers here. Your onboarding service provider reviews the application and brings you into the dataspace.

run.title: Run
run.text: Your provider runs what you need to take part, such as connectors and wallets as a service, so you do not have to host them yourself.

trust.title: Trust
trust.text: The Core Service Provider keeps the dataspace trusted: the trusted providers, the business partner numbers and their home provider, and the discovery.
